title: Zesty Slovakian Noodle Stir-fry
description: A vibrant, macrobiotic-friendly stir-fry featuring brown rice noodles, tofu, and a zesty sauce, cooked in a fondue pot for a post-workout boost.
instructions: Rinse brown rice noodles and soak in warm water for 20 minutes, then drain.
Cut tofu into 1 cm cubes and pat dry with paper towels.
Slice broccoli, carrots, bell pepper, and snow peas into bite-sized pieces.
Heat fondue-pot over medium heat and add sesame oil.
Add tofu cubes to the hot oil, brown on all sides, then remove tofu and set aside.
In the same pot, add minced garlic, grated ginger, and crushed red pepper flakes; sauté for 30 seconds.
Add all vegetables to the pot and stir-fry until just tender, about 5 minutes.
Return tofu to the pot, pour soy sauce, lime juice, and a splash of water to create steam, then cover and simmer for 3 minutes.
Stir in drained noodles and cilantro, mixing well to coat with sauce.
Serve hot, garnished with extra cilantro and lime wedges if desired.
